test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

All in the same boat

options.text: When everyone is dealing with the same situation
When everyone has to start all over again
When a task can be accomplished together
When everybody is travelling in the same vehicle

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"All in the same boat"** means when everyone is dealing with the same situation. (सभी एक ही स्थिति का सामना कर रहे हैं) • **Example: **During the lockdown, we were all in the same boat, trying to adjust to the new normal. • **"All in the same boat"** is used to express solidarity or shared challenges among a group of people. (साझी चुनौतियों का सामना करना) • **Example: **The employees felt that they were all in the same boat when the company announced layoffs. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2:** When everyone has to start all over again (जब सभी को फिर से शुरू करना पड़ता है) • **Example:** After the project failed, we realized we were back to square one and had to start all over again. • **Option 3:** When a task can be accomplished together (जब एक कार्य को मिलकर पूरा किया जा सकता है) • **Example:** Cleaning the park will be easier if we all work together to accomplish the task. • **Option 4:** When everybody is travelling in the same vehicle (जब सभी एक ही वाहन में यात्रा कर रहे होते हैं) • **Example:** We decided to carpool to save on fuel costs, so we were all in the same vehicle. 1c1:T871, **Given:- ** The movement of elements in the figure is indicated through arrows. please carefully observe the direction of the arrow.
